description: Looking for a twist on your basic black metal bed frame? Look no further than our Trisha Platforma Bed. This bold steel foundation does the work of both a frame and box spring, all while giving your room a modern, polished feel. It’s also built with a 7-inch, low profile that’s especially well suited for taller mattresses. Although no matter the thickness of your mattress, Trisha’s sturdy wood mattress platform is built to give it optimal, sag-free support. And assembling it couldn’t be simpler. Everything you need to put it together in under an hour is included in the shipping box, like tools and step-by-step instructions. A 5-year warranty is also included, so you can worry less and relax more. The Trisha Platforma Bed is proof that a sleek and minimal look doesn’t have to mean minimal support.
